subject: dapper stapler character
pose: 微仰头，一只小手整理侧盖
art_direction: 旧式金属订书机变成低重心长嘴绅士，酒红机身与奶油小手，礼貌抬头。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Turn a compact vintage stapler into a dapper character, using its long upper casing as a dignified beak-like face. Keep the jaw closed and the metal mechanism safely hidden. Add two cream-colored mitten hands and short rubber feet, with one hand tidying a small side panel as if adjusting a lapel. The burgundy enamel shows a few worn edges, while the base is brushed steel. Place it on a muted teal field in three-quarter view. Give the character an understated pleased expression, without letters, office clutter, or human clothing. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
